summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text object with clickable_ranges click spans added last; Opacity keeps segment style attributes such as meta; the layout resolver needed no change because Edge already declares size, min_size, and fraction. Added tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, plus tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and tests/widgets/__init__.py, and docs/reference/tabs.md. Tests were not run, so all results are unverified. Known gaps: an empty label is treated as flexible by the resolver, and the sandbox demo was skipped. Also, one find command surfaced paths in other experiment directories and I read one vendored rich/style.py from there; nothing from it went into the code.
